title: Self-hosted applications with free OIDC login
notes: These projects can be self-hosted and provide basic OIDC/OAuth2 login without buying an SSO add-on.
You still need an OIDC identity provider, such as Keycloak, authentik, or Zitadel.
Hosting, support, advanced provisioning, and group-sync features may have separate commercial offerings. Verify the feature against the version you deploy.
Outline, Directus, Dockhand, HashiCorp Vault & Boundary are included because their free self-hosted edition includes OIDC, but their current BSL and MSCL licenses are not OSI-approved open source

rejected.name: Mattermost
rejected.reason: OIDC login is only in the free-but-proprietary Entry edition (aimed at teams under 50 users); the open-source Team Edition has no SSO support at all.

rejected.name: Portainer BE
rejected.reason: The edition with full SSO features is proprietary and only free for up to 3 nodes for non-commercial use; the open-source Portainer CE is listed instead.

rejected.name: Stirling PDF
rejected.reason: OAuth2/OIDC single sign-on requires a paid Server-tier license and SAML requires the Enterprise tier; the free open-source edition does not include SSO.
